name: Lucky Tooth
desc: Somebody's. It has been lucky for exactly one of you so far.

name: Heavy Knucklebone
desc: Held in the fist. Adds nothing but weight, and weight is enough.

name: Cracked Spectacles
desc: You see the gap in their guard, and also two of it.

name: Courier's Anklet
desc: Worn by people who are paid to already be elsewhere.

name: Forged Guild Licence
desc: Not a real guild. Not a real licence. Genuinely intimidating.

name: Saint's Fingerbone, Disputed
desc: Somebody's. The paperwork proving whose burned down with the abbey.

name: The Quiet Stone
desc: Holding it, you can hear yourself think. This is not always welcome.

name: Ring of the Overcommitted
desc: Makes every swing count for more, including the ones that miss.

name: Earplugs of the Unmoved
desc: You cannot hear the words. It transpires the words were the problem.

name: Somebody Else's Medal
desc: Awarded for valour. Not to you. It does not seem to mind.

name: Cold Iron Collar
desc: Nothing gets in. Very little gets out. It was not designed for you.

name: Pendant of Deferred Consequence
desc: Whatever was going to happen is still going to happen. Later.
